x: In the Senior events we saw Holtum win the 100 yards, and he was also 2nd in the 220, while Bill Lucas won the 1 mile in 4 min. 36.3 secs., and John Bromley, making a return after an operation for appendicitis, was 2nd to Peter Pirie in the 2 miles.

Jack continued his fine running of this road season and finished only 10 yards behind Reed and in so doing beat the old course record by 15 seconds. Walker then conceded 30 seconds to Peter Pirie and Roffey finishing, had little chance of catching Morgan of S.L.H.
